name: hud_ui_circle_draw_dirty
description: HudUiCircle::Draw draws the base element image path and rasterizes the circle outline.
known_limits: tier S evidence is tracked by the hud_ui_circle_draw_dirty VC target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bc4c0 validates ftable slot 2 DrawBase dispatch, then zRndr_DrawCircleOutline16_Framebuffer(base.x, base.y, radius, color565, 0).

The native smoke uses a derived test circle to capture DrawBase dispatch, patches the active zRndr point callback, and verifies circle outline globals plus color forwarding without modifying production dispatch-table data.
